name: Micronaut Core 5.2.24
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Finish HTTP/1 responses consistently on the fast path and on connection close by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14453
* Fix the inverted pending connection hint of the client pool by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14459
* Wind down HTTP/1 client connections on their event loop by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14458
* Release the client connection when a request fails before it is sent by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14457
* Read HTTP/2 stream state on the event loop when writing a full response by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14454
* Close listeners that were bound when a later listener fails to bind by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14455
* Acknowledge form data that was buffered before the demuxer was created by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14456
### Improvements ⭐
* Return null from splitAcceptHeader when the first entry is empty by @hauke-d in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14349
* Allow annotation-processing environments to disable logging by @lissam1 in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14441
### Other Changes 💡
* Evaluate expressions in the declared metadata of expression aware annotation metadata by @sdelamo in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14466


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.23...v5.2.24
